content: अपी [अपि-इ] €2 <ab>P.</ab> (Mostly Vedic) .²1 To go in or near, enter into or upon, approach. .²2 To have a share in, partake of, suffer; जरामृत्युं पुनरेवापियन्ति <ls>Muṇḍ. 1. 2. 7</ls>. .²3 To join, flow, flow into, dissolve, be resolved into; स्वमपीतो भवति तस्मादेनं स्वपितीत्याचक्षते <ls>Ch. Up.</ls> .²4 To die. .²5 To pour out (as a river).
